description: Estimate capital gains tax on one sale of shares or property by a resident individual, for 71 countries (AE, AR, AT, AU, BE, BG, BR, CA, CH, CL, CN, CO, CY, CZ, DE, DK, EE, EG, ES, FI, FR, GB, GH, GR, GT, HK, HR, HU, ID, IE, IL, IN, IS, IT, JM, JP, KE, KR, LI, LK, LT, LU, LV, MT, MU, MX, MY, NG, NL, NO, NZ, PH, PK, PL, PT, QA, RO, RS, RU, SA, SE, SG, SI, SK, TR, TW, TZ, UA, UG, US, ZA). Where the country's rule can be computed the answer is a figure; where it depends on facts the engine cannot model, the answer is the rule itself (rate, holding period, annual exemption, main residence) with the reason — never a borrowed number. Any other country returns 'not covered'. Pass income (other taxable income for the year) where the gain is taxed at marginal rates, and heldMoreThan12Months or holdingMonths where the holding period matters (the Australian 50% discount, the US long-term rate). capitalLosses apply before any discount. Finland (FI) adds its own detail: the better of the actual cost or the deemed acquisition cost (hankintameno-olettama: 20% of the price, 40% after 10 years), the 1 000 € small-disposals rule and 30%/34% capital income tax — pass yearsHeld, and otherCapitalIncome if there is any; costBase may be omitted there. Each answer cites the capital-gains source and date for that country — not the GST/VAT one. For pay without an asset sale use income_tax_estimate. Non-resident rules are out of scope.

asset.description: What was sold: 'shares' (shares and funds) or 'property' (real estate). Rules differ by asset in many countries

capitalLosses.description: Capital losses to offset — applied before any discount; FI: from this year or carried forward (five years)

costBase.description: What the asset cost, in local currency, including eligible incidental costs. Required except for FI, where omitting it uses the deemed acquisition cost (pass FI buying and selling costs as saleExpenses)

country.description: 2-letter ISO code of a covered country (upper case); defaults to AU

heldMoreThan12Months.description: True when the asset was held at least 12 months (e.g. the AU 50% discount, the US long-term rate). Shorthand for holdingMonths: true = 12, false = 0

holdingMonths.description: Whole months the asset was held; overrides heldMoreThan12Months

income.description: Other taxable income for the year, in local currency — sets the marginal rate where the gain is taxed as income (e.g. AU, US short-term). Required where the rule needs it; the answer says so

otherCapitalIncome.description: FI: other capital income this year (dividends, rent, other gains) — decides how much of the gain falls above the 30 000 € threshold

proceeds.description: Sale price of the asset, in local currency

saleExpenses.description: FI: brokerage, fees and other costs of buying and selling

taxYear.description: FI: calendar tax year like '2026'; omit for the current year

totalProceedsThisYear.description: FI: the year's total sale prices, this sale included, for the 1 000 € small-disposals rule; omit when this is the only sale

yearsHeld.description: FI: whole years owned — 10 or more raises the deemed acquisition cost from 20% to 40% of the price

name: cgt_estimate

assumptions.description: Assumptions the answer depends on — relay them with the figure

cgtPayable.description: Extra tax caused by the gain, in local currency; null when rule-only

costDeducted.description: FI: the cost deducted from the price

dataVerifiedOn.description: ISO date the rate data was last confirmed against the authority

disclaimer.description: General-information note that must accompany any figure shown to a person

discountApplied.description: Whether a discount or inclusion rate reduced the taxable gain (e.g. the AU 50% discount). Always false for FI

exemptionApplied.description: Annual exempt amount or allowance used, where there is one

grossGain.description: Proceeds minus cost (FI: minus the larger of actual or deemed cost). Floored at 0, local currency

loss.description: FI: the loss on this sale, if any (only ever from the actual cost)

lossDeductible.description: FI: whether that loss can be deducted

mayBeStale.description: True once the verification date is over a year old — re-confirm with the authority

method.description: FI: whether the actual cost or the deemed acquisition cost was deducted

notes.description: FI: rules that decided the answer, in plain words

reason.description: Why no figure was computed (rule-only), in plain words

rule.description: The country's rule as written, for relaying — especially when status is rule-only

smallDisposalsExempt.description: FI: true when the year's sale prices total 1 000 € or less, making every gain tax-free

source.description: The national tax authority the figures were verified against (e.g. 'ATO — ato.gov.au')

sourceUrl.description: https link to the authority page the rate was verified against. Present only on rate answers backed by a verified ledger row — absent (never empty) otherwise, so its presence is itself the claim

status.description: 'computed' = a figure; 'rule-only' = the rule text and the reason no figure is given (cgtPayable and taxableGain are then null)

step.description: Which holding-period step applied, when the rule has steps

taxYear.description: Tax year whose rules were used, when the rule is year-based

taxableGain.description: Gain the tax was charged on; null when rule-only

title: Capital gains tax estimate (71 countries)
